citations.P3: inserting `Disputed` before `Paid` shifts `Paid` 2→3 and `Void` 3→4, so every existing row in the `invoices` SMALLINT column reads back as the wrong state; append `Disputed` at the end of the enum, or ship a data migration
citations.P4: Helm values still set `INVOICE_GRACE_DAYS`** (prod `21`, staging `14`) — zod strips the unknown key silently, so prod falls to the new default of 7
citations.P5: `--filter='[origin/main]'` skipped `@acme/notifier`, `@acme/reconciler-client` and `@acme/scripts`, which is exactly where #3 and #4 live
citations.P6: Serializer tests were weakened to `toBeTruthy()`/`toBeDefined()`** — they now pass for any value and dropped the currency check; assert `'settled'` and `{amount: '125.00', currency: 'GBP'}`
citations.P7: these are in this repo and this diff, so the "platform team has confirmed downstream" note does not cover them
citations.P8: `events.ts` publishes `toInvoiceResponse(inv)` to `billing.invoice.updated`, so every subscriber gets the new shape; the PR description only mentions the HTTP endpoint
citations.P9: Version and announce the event schema, or keep the event on the old serializer.
citations.P10: re-run typecheck and test across the whole repo before merging
citations.P11: `GET /v1/invoices/:id` omits `rateBps` while dunning passes it** — the fee quoted to the customer diverges from the fee actually applied as soon as `LATE_FEE_RATE_BPS` moves off 150
